purpose: Broaden ParkPulse case coverage across common amusement-park operating incidents, using public safety/operations patterns as scenario templates rather than copying any private park procedures.
research_basis: IAAPA safety/security and operational best-practice categories: ride evacuation, guest behavior, accessibility, security, emergency procedures, and safe operations culture.
CPSC amusement ride incident narratives: restraint issues, struck-by objects, ride stops, falls, guest illness, and injury-response patterns.
Crowd-safety decision-support research: density, weather, sentiment, purpose, and flow risk as operational aggravating factors.
Public theme-park operations case studies and reports: staffing allocation, key/equipment control, queue variance, food-service queues, power outage, and downtime communication.

decision_rules.name: Broad Scenario Case Retrieval
decision_rules.condition: Operator text describes an incident, guest-care issue, ride disruption, crowd risk, staffing issue, weather event, food pressure, waterpark emergency, equipment problem, or communications need.
decision_rules.allowed_action: Retrieve a case template, interpret allowed and blocked moves, require evidence, and produce a bounded action plan.
decision_rules.blocked_action: Treat a high-risk real-world incident as a food/status/report request or generic queue optimization.
human_review_if: security, medical, evacuation, lost child, ride evacuation, or safety-critical maintenance is involved

action_cases.title: Ride evacuation with guests stopped on course
action_plan: Escalate to ride operations and maintenance command.
Hold intake and protect evacuation access paths.
Draft calm guest messaging without promising reopening time.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Confirm evacuation authority and maintenance status.
Hold intake and clear access lane.

action_cases.success_metric: Guests remain accounted for and evacuation path stays clear.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Access path blocked or unauthorized restart attempted.

action_cases.title: Guest reports restraint or seatbelt concern
action_plan: Stop new loading for the affected seat/train until checked.
Escalate to certified ride lead and maintenance.
Do not clear or reopen through the agent.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Hold affected dispatch and request certified inspection.

action_cases.success_metric: Certified check acknowledges before any further dispatch.
action_cases.rollback_condition: No maintenance acknowledgement or repeated restraint complaint.

action_cases.title: Loose article or dropped phone in restricted ride area
action_plan: Do not allow guest retrieval.
Hold affected access point and notify ride/maintenance team.
Message guest that retrieval follows safety procedure.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Secure restricted area and follow retrieval protocol.

action_cases.success_metric: Restricted area remains guest-free and hazard is logged.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Guest attempts entry or object affects ride envelope.

action_cases.title: Block-zone or automatic safety stop creates queue surge
action_plan: Treat stop as safety-controlled until cleared.
Hold intake and split queue demand to capped alternatives.
Give honest delay reason without technical speculation.
blocked_actions: route all guests to one ride

receiver_payloads.instruction: Explain delay and capped alternatives.

action_cases.success_metric: Queue pressure falls without unsafe restart pressure.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Destination density exceeds cap or clearance remains unknown.

action_cases.title: Outdoor ride closure from lightning, wind, or storm risk
action_plan: Taper exposed queues and hold outdoor intake.
Route guests to indoor/covered capacity with caps.
Preserve emergency and accessibility routes.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Route to covered alternatives and explain weather hold.

action_cases.success_metric: Exposed queue density drops and shelter density remains below cap.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Shelter area exceeds safe density.

action_cases.title: Guest illness or vomiting in ride queue
action_plan: Route care/cleaning team to the queue zone.
Create a small bypass or hold section without exposing guest details.
Protect access and reduce crowding around the guest.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Respond to queue illness and preserve privacy.

action_cases.success_metric: Care/cleaning acknowledgement and queue flow restored safely.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Crowd gathers or guest details leak.

action_cases.title: Accessibility boarding conflict at ride platform
action_plan: Escalate to trained accessibility lead.
Keep platform flow calm and protect accessible route.
Do not decide eligibility or disclose guest details.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Review boarding support and keep route clear.

action_cases.success_metric: Accessibility lead acknowledges and platform remains clear.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Accessible route blocked or guest privacy exposed.

action_cases.title: Repeated sensor anomaly or minor ride fault
action_plan: Keep the action advisory until maintenance reviews fault history.
Taper queue intake and message uncertainty.
Recommend alternate capacity without declaring root cause.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Review repeated fault before operations change.

action_cases.success_metric: Maintenance review logged and queue demand reduced.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Fault repeats or ride status remains ambiguous.

action_cases.title: Height or safety-rule dispute at ride entrance
action_plan: Support staff with policy-safe explanation.
Offer nearby alternatives without overriding rule.
Escalate only if conflict grows.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Use safety-rule script and offer alternatives.

action_cases.success_metric: Conflict de-escalates and rule remains enforced.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Guest conflict escalates or crowd blocks entrance.

action_cases.title: Queue spillback blocks midway flow
action_plan: Freeze queue growth at spillback point.
Open split-flow route or overflow zone if safe.
Send crowd lead to protect access lanes.
blocked_actions: send all guests to one alternate

receiver_payloads.instruction: Hold spillback boundary and split flow.

action_cases.success_metric: Path congestion drops below threshold.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Access lane blocked or overflow density rises.

action_cases.title: Crowd crush risk at pinch point
action_plan: Escalate to crowd/safety command.
Stop inbound flow into the pinch point.
Open relief route and protect emergency access.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve immediate flow stop and relief routing.

action_cases.success_metric: Density and path congestion drop with access maintained.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Density remains critical after intervention.

action_cases.title: Parade or show route blocked by queue/crowd
action_plan: Hold queue growth near route crossing.
Pre-stage crowd leads at crossings.
Split release away from route.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Hold crossing clear and split flow.

action_cases.success_metric: Route remains clear through event wave.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Crossing congestion rises or route access compromised.

action_cases.title: Fireworks exit surge overwhelms transit/lockers
action_plan: Send pre-release transit and locker guidance.
Meter exit paths while preserving access lanes.
Hold promotions away from front gate.
blocked_actions: direct all guests to front gate

receiver_payloads.instruction: Send transit/locker guidance before release.

action_cases.success_metric: Exit density peaks below threshold.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Access lane blocked or transit queue becomes critical.

action_cases.title: Show release overloads nearby food court
action_plan: Redirect a share of show crowd to lower-wait food and attractions.
Throttle food promotions near overloaded location.
Message lower-wait alternatives.
blocked_actions: send all show guests to food court

receiver_payloads.instruction: Offer lower-wait food and attraction alternatives.

action_cases.success_metric: Food pickup ETA drops or stabilizes.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Alternate destination overloads.

action_cases.title: Entrance security or bag-check backup
action_plan: Open staffed lanes only if trained staff available.
Message expected entry delay and alternate prep guidance.
Do not weaken screening standards.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve trained lane support if available.

action_cases.success_metric: Entry wait falls without screening exception.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Untrained staffing or access blockage detected.

action_cases.title: Parking arrival surge creates entry delay
action_plan: Message arrival guidance and alternate entry timing.
Coordinate parking leads and front gate staffing.
Protect pedestrian crossings.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Coordinate lot flow and pedestrian crossing protection.

action_cases.success_metric: Arrival queue and pedestrian conflict decline.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Pedestrian crossing becomes blocked.

action_cases.title: Mobile order ETA spike
action_plan: Publish honest ETA and lower-wait alternatives.
Throttle demand-generating promotions.
Request trained runner support if labor rules allow.
blocked_actions: send all demand to one stand

receiver_payloads.instruction: Show ETA and alternatives.

action_cases.success_metric: Pickup ETA improves within window.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Alternate stand becomes overloaded.

action_cases.title: Water or cooling item low stock during heat
action_plan: Prioritize restock to heat-risk zones.
Message refill stations and shaded alternatives.
Avoid demand spike promotions.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Prioritize water/cooling restock to heat zones.

action_cases.success_metric: Low-stock item recovers or demand shifts safely.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Heat complaints rise or restock fails.

action_cases.title: Food POS or payment outage
action_plan: Confirm affected locations and payment modes.
Route guests to working locations with capacity caps.
Message payment limitation honestly.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Explain payment outage and working alternatives.

action_cases.success_metric: Complaint rate and queue at affected POS decline.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Alternate locations overload.

action_cases.title: Allergen or dietary safety complaint
action_plan: Escalate to food safety lead.
Do not give medical advice or guarantee safety through the agent.
Preserve privacy and document location/item.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Review allergen complaint and preserve privacy.

action_cases.success_metric: Food safety lead acknowledges and affected item/location reviewed.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Medical symptoms appear or item remains in service unchecked.

action_cases.title: Multiple heat illness complaints
action_plan: Stage care teams and shade/water guidance.
Route guests to lower-density indoor cooling zones.
Protect HVAC comfort and emergency lanes.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Guide to shade, water, and cooling zones.

action_cases.success_metric: Heat complaints and high-risk queue density decline.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Indoor cooling density exceeds cap.

action_cases.title: Lightning shelter demand exceeds covered capacity
action_plan: Stop sending all guests to one shelter.
Split guests across covered zones with caps.
Keep emergency/accessibility routes clear.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Meter shelter entries and split overflow.

action_cases.success_metric: Covered zone density remains under cap.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Shelter density or access blockage becomes critical.

action_cases.title: Smoke or air-quality event affects outdoor areas
action_plan: Route sensitive guests to indoor filtered areas if available.
Avoid medical diagnosis and disclose uncertainty.
Protect HVAC comfort and crowd caps.
blocked_actions: tell guests health risk is absent

receiver_payloads.instruction: Provide indoor/covered options and operational status.

action_cases.success_metric: Outdoor exposure queues reduce without indoor overload.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Indoor density exceeds cap or air condition worsens.

action_cases.title: Waterpark lifeguard rescue or aquatic emergency
action_plan: Escalate to aquatic emergency command.
Clear deck access and pause affected attraction.
Keep guest details private.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Confirm rescue protocol and deck access.

action_cases.success_metric: Aquatic response acknowledges and deck access clear.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Deck crowd blocks response route.

action_cases.title: Pool chemical or contamination closure
action_plan: Close affected water attraction pending certified clearance.
Route guests to alternatives with capacity caps.
Do not speculate on chemistry or reopening time.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Explain closure and alternatives without speculation.

action_cases.success_metric: Affected area cleared and alternatives stay below cap.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Guests re-enter closed water area.

action_cases.title: Fight or aggressive behavior in queue
action_plan: Escalate to security and crowd leads.
Create distance around incident and protect queue exits.
Avoid public blame or identifying details.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Respond to queue conflict and protect exits.

action_cases.success_metric: Security acknowledges and crowd disperses around incident.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Crowd gathers or exit becomes blocked.

action_cases.title: Unattended bag or suspicious item
action_plan: Escalate to security command.
Create bounded perimeter without panic messaging.
Route guests around the area.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Assess item and approve perimeter.

action_cases.success_metric: Security acknowledges and perimeter is established.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Guest/staff touches item or perimeter fails.

action_cases.title: Separated adult or vulnerable guest needs assistance
action_plan: Escalate to guest-care/security with privacy constraints.
Coordinate staff search without public identifying broadcast.
Keep reunification point clear.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Coordinate privacy-safe search and reunification.

action_cases.success_metric: Approved response team acknowledges and search zones assigned.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Personal details leak or no team acknowledgement.

action_cases.title: Serious medical complaint reported
action_plan: Escalate to trained medical/security response immediately.
Clear access route and reduce surrounding crowd.
Do not diagnose or give treatment advice.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Dispatch trained response and clear access.

action_cases.success_metric: Medical response acknowledges and path remains clear.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Access blocked or response not acknowledged.

action_cases.title: Accessibility elevator or ramp outage
action_plan: Find accessible alternate route with staff verification.
Message affected guests privately and clearly.
Do not route mobility guests through unsafe path.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Verify accessible alternate route.

action_cases.success_metric: Accessible route confirmed and affected guests assisted.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Alternate route unverified or blocked.

action_cases.title: Certified operator shortage for ride/role
action_plan: Identify certified coverage before operating change.
Taper intake if coverage is below requirement.
Protect breaks and avoid untrained substitution.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve certified redeploy or intake taper.

action_cases.success_metric: Certified coverage restored or intake safely tapered.
action_cases.rollback_condition: No certified staff acknowledges.

action_cases.title: Callouts affect both ride and food operations
action_plan: Prioritize safety-critical coverage before service speed.
Taper lower-priority demand and message waits.
Do not violate protected breaks.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Prioritize certified safety coverage and service taper.

action_cases.success_metric: Safety coverage maintained and service queues stabilize.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Safety coverage drops.

action_cases.title: Staff fatigue during heat/weather pressure
action_plan: Protect breaks and rotate exposed posts if certified coverage exists.
Reduce demand into exposed queues.
Stage hydration/cooling support.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve fatigue-safe rotation plan.

action_cases.success_metric: Fatigue pressure declines without coverage loss.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Coverage or break compliance fails.

action_cases.title: Partial power outage affects rides/lighting/POS
action_plan: Treat affected rides/equipment as safety-held until cleared.
Prioritize emergency lighting and access.
Message affected services without restart promises.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Confirm affected systems and safety priorities.

action_cases.success_metric: Affected zones secured and guest flow redirected safely.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Emergency lighting/access compromised.

action_cases.title: Ride/facilities key or equipment control missing
action_plan: Escalate to facilities/security key-control owner.
Do not bypass lockout or control procedure.
Hold affected equipment/ride action pending verified key status.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Resolve key-control exception before operation.

action_cases.success_metric: Key status reconciled and affected equipment remains safe-held.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Unauthorized operation attempted.

action_cases.title: Indoor cooling/HVAC failure during heat
action_plan: Protect comfort load and route guests to alternate cooled zones.
Avoid sending more guests to the failed zone.
Escalate facilities review.
blocked_actions: route guests into hot indoor zone

receiver_payloads.instruction: Review degraded HVAC and protect guest comfort.

action_cases.success_metric: Affected indoor density falls and comfort route opens.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Heat complaints or density rises in failed zone.

action_cases.title: Digital signage gives conflicting directions
action_plan: Freeze conflicting sign update and verify source of truth.
Send corrected staff guidance and guest message if needed.
Do not invent wait/direction values.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Verify and correct conflicting sign state.

action_cases.success_metric: Conflicting sign removed or corrected.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Guests continue following wrong route.

action_cases.title: Guest app/push notification sends wrong guidance
action_plan: Pause repeat sends and publish corrected guidance after verification.
Avoid overcorrecting with unverified claims.
Track affected segment aggregate only.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Send verified correction only.

action_cases.success_metric: Corrected message delivered and route confusion falls.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Second correction required or confusion increases.

action_cases.title: Viral video or public incident communication risk
action_plan: Escalate to communications and incident command.
Keep facts verified and privacy-safe.
Do not speculate or assign blame.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Prepare verified, privacy-safe holding statement.

action_cases.success_metric: Comms owner acknowledges and unverified claims are avoided.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Private details or speculation appear.

action_cases.title: Guest asks for compensation after downtime/wait
action_plan: Acknowledge issue and route to guest-care policy owner.
Offer aggregate alternatives, not individualized promises.
Escalate compensation approval to human operator.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Review compensation request under policy.

action_cases.success_metric: Guest-care owner acknowledges and response stays policy-safe.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Unauthorized compensation promise made.

action_cases.title: Merchandise or locker queue spike
action_plan: Meter entry and route overflow away from main path.
Message alternate retail/locker options.
Do not block egress or accessibility routes.
blocked_actions: send all guests to one shop

receiver_payloads.instruction: Meter entry and protect path.

action_cases.success_metric: Retail/locker queue no longer blocks path.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Path or exit becomes blocked.

action_cases.title: Animal exhibit crowding or guest behavior issue
action_plan: Escalate to animal care/security lead.
Reduce crowd density and reinforce behavior guidance.
Protect staff/animal access routes.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Reduce exhibit crowding and protect access.

action_cases.success_metric: Exhibit density and behavior risk decline.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Keeper route blocked or behavior worsens.

action_cases.title: Temporary event barrier or stanchion failure
action_plan: Escalate to event operations and safety lead.
Create safe perimeter and route guests away.
Do not move barriers without approved owner.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve barrier correction and safe routing.

action_cases.success_metric: Barrier hazard isolated and routes remain clear.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Guests enter hazard or access blocked.

action_cases.title: Night lighting failure on guest path
action_plan: Route guests away from dark path if safe alternate exists.
Escalate facilities lighting response.
Protect accessibility and emergency routes.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Respond to path lighting failure.

action_cases.success_metric: Dark path avoided or lighting restored.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Guests continue using dark path.

action_cases.title: Live state sensor or data feed stale
action_plan: Mark affected data as stale and avoid automated action from it.
Request human verification or secondary source.
Keep recommendations read-only until verified.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Verify stale source against secondary observation.

action_cases.success_metric: Data freshness restored or verified manually.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Agent action attempted from stale source.

action_cases.title: Receiver dispatch lacks acknowledgement
action_plan: Do not assume action executed.
Escalate or retry idempotently according to receiver policy.
Keep map state as proposed until acknowledgement or observation.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Review missing acknowledgement before state mutation.

action_cases.success_metric: Acknowledgement or verified observation received.
action_cases.rollback_condition: No ack after retry window.

action_cases.title: Operator text contains guest PII
action_plan: Minimize and redact PII from broad traces.
Route sensitive details only to approved care/security team.
Continue action using aggregate/non-identifying context.
blocked_actions: show private details in public panel

receiver_payloads.instruction: Handle PII through approved channel only.

action_cases.success_metric: PII excluded from public response and broad traces.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Sensitive detail appears in guest-facing channel.

action_cases.title: Opening or closing wave staffing mismatch
action_plan: Prioritize crowd leads and safety-critical posts.
Meter entry/exit waves and message timing.
Do not move certified ride staff below requirement.
blocked_actions: send all guests through one gate

receiver_payloads.instruction: Approve wave staffing plan.

action_cases.success_metric: Wave density stays below threshold with coverage intact.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Coverage gap or gate congestion becomes critical.

action_cases.title: Rain creates slip/fall cluster on path
action_plan: Dispatch facilities/custodial response and guest-care if needed.
Route guests around affected path.
Do not diagnose injuries.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Treat wet path and set safe routing.

action_cases.success_metric: Slip reports stop and path condition verified.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Additional slips occur.

action_cases.title: Child height dispute creates crowd conflict
action_plan: Keep safety rule non-negotiable.
Move conversation out of queue flow with lead support.
Offer compatible alternatives without compensation promise.

receiver_payloads.instruction: Move dispute out of flow and explain safety rule.

action_cases.success_metric: Queue flow resumes and safety rule remains enforced.
action_cases.rollback_condition: Conflict blocks queue or staff overrides rule.
